note: Media Library Media Modify provides: a field type entity_reference_entity_modify ('Media with contextual modifications', default target_type media, extra overwritten_property_map JSON column); a field widget media_library_media_modify_widget ('Media library extra') extending core MediaLibraryWidget with settings form_mode/multi_edit_on_create/no_edit_on_create/check_selected/replace_checkbox_by_order_indicator; a Views field media_library_media_modify_edit_link; a Drush command media_library_media_modify:migrate <entity_type> <field>; and the service media_library_media_modify (EntityReferenceOverrideService). No configure route, no permissions. Cases are grounded in that real field type/widget config and the migrate command. Introspection reads back the configured widget type / a widget setting on a live form display; execution creates a modify field with the widget, and migrates a plain entity_reference field to the modify type.

evals.prompt: On a Drupal 11 site with media_library_media_modify, I want editors to give a referenced media item different field values (e.g. a different caption) on each piece of content, without changing the media entity itself. Which field type and which field widget do I use?
evals.expected_output: Add a field of type entity_reference_entity_modify ('Media with contextual modifications') and choose the media_library_media_modify_widget ('Media library extra') form widget. Overrides are stored per-instance as a JSON overwritten_property_map and applied to a clone at render time; the source media is never modified.

evals.prompt: I already have a plain entity_reference media field and want it to support media_library_media_modify's contextual overrides. Is there a Drush command to convert it, and what arguments does it take?
evals.expected_output: Yes: `drush media_library_media_modify:migrate <entity_type_id> <field_name>` (e.g. `drush media_library_media_modify:migrate node field_media`). It changes the entity_reference field storage/config to entity_reference_entity_modify, adds the overwritten_property_map column, and switches form-display components to the modify widget.

evals.prompt: How do I let editors edit media items inline from within the media library modal using media_library_media_modify? Which Views field do I add and to which view/display?
must_contain_any: Edit link for the Media Library
evals.expected_output: Add the Views field 'Edit link for the Media Library' (media_library_media_modify_edit_link) to the media library view's widget display. It renders an AJAX Edit button that opens the media edit form in the library modal; which fields appear is controlled by the media type's media_library form display.

evals.prompt: The Article content type on this site has a field named field_mlmm_probe for context-aware media. Inspect the live default form display and state the machine name of the field-widget type configured for it.
evals.expected_output: The widget is media_library_media_modify_widget ('Media library extra'), read from core.entity_form_display.node.article.default -> content.field_mlmm_probe.type.

evals.prompt: On this site, the Article field field_mlmm_setting uses the media_library_media_modify 'Media library extra' widget. Inspect its live widget settings and state which on-create behaviour setting is enabled (true).
evals.expected_output: multi_edit_on_create is true (no_edit_on_create is false). Read it from core.entity_form_display.node.article.default -> content.field_mlmm_setting.settings.multi_edit_on_create.

evals.prompt: On this Drupal site, add a field named field_mlmm_task to the Article content type that supports media_library_media_modify contextual overrides (field type entity_reference_entity_modify, targeting media), and configure its default form display to use the module's 'Media library extra' widget. Apply the change to the live site.
evals.expected_output: Create FieldStorageConfig node.field_mlmm_task type entity_reference_entity_modify (target_type media) + FieldConfig on article, and set the node.article.default form-display component for field_mlmm_task to widget media_library_media_modify_widget.

evals.prompt: This site's Article type has a plain entity_reference media field field_mlmm_mig. Using media_library_media_modify, convert it in place so it supports contextual overrides (its storage type becomes entity_reference_entity_modify). Apply the change to the live site.
evals.expected_output: Run `drush media_library_media_modify:migrate node field_mlmm_mig`. Afterwards field.storage.node.field_mlmm_mig has type entity_reference_entity_modify.
